rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-3 INIT_T lever, breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: iter-1 (init_t0.7/relax0.5) SSIM 0.326/PSNR 17.1/RMSE 4.75e-2; iter-2 (init_t0.7/relax1.0) SSIM 0.354/PSNR 16.5/RMSE 5.12e-2 -- full DC did NOT rescue, both ~9x worse than baseline (PSNR 36.3/RMSE 5.21e-3), hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: init_t=0.7 embeds the FBP at high flow-time where most FBP structure is replaced by noise; 8 Euler steps of the 512^2 wavelet prior cannot rebuild breast detail from that, and even full CG DC can't fix a trajectory that started from mostly-noise. The dominant lever is init_t, not dc_relax (the archived Mayo-prior curve's big SSIM gains 0.82->0.91 came from lowering init_t 0.7->0.2). (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init_t 0.7 -> 0.4 (embed FBP closer to clean, far less prior drift), keeping dc_relax=1.0 from iter-2. (4) HYPOTHESIS: at init_t=0.4 the FBP is embedded near-clean so the wavelet prior only lightly denoises the sparse-view streaks while full CG DC pins the measured rays -> RMSE drops sharply toward the sparse-FBP floor and may clear hr>0 (this is the archived best region). FALSIFIER: if still PSNR<<36, even light prior injection + DC can't beat the strong 128-view FBP baseline here -> iter-4 pushes init_t lower (0.2) and/or raises dc_n_cg. (5) BUDGET: ~90s/iter, init_t is free. (6) Loop continues; iter-4 self-dispatched on landing.
